requirement: The system shall show a client's documented MCV doses with date and vaccine and how each counts (MCV0 MCV1 MCV2 invalid not counted)
The system shall treat a client with no documented MCV dose as unvaccinated
The system shall determine the MCV dose due today from age and valid doses and the national schedule setting
The system shall not limit MCV1 or MCV2 to the target ages and shall offer missed doses at any contact
The system shall record any MCV dose given before 9 months as MCV0 and keep MCV1 and MCV2 due
The system shall never record a dose as MCV2 for a client without a valid MCV1
The system shall prompt the screening questions (allergy to a component; severe immunosuppression; pregnancy; other live vaccine in the last 4 weeks) before vaccination
The system shall record the reason a client was not vaccinated and the return date
The system shall calculate the next MCV due date and print it for the home-based record
The system shall flag the additional dose for an HIV-infected child on HAART
The system shall list children overdue for MCV1 or MCV2 and zero-dose children each month
The system shall compute IND.01 to IND.07 and produce the Joint Reporting Form measles rows
The system shall record a health worker's proof of measles immunity or immunization
